name: slate-3m
js: const L = __fp.livery.slate, p = __fp.player, cx = L.x + L.face[0] * 2.6 + L.face[1] * 0.8, cz = L.z + L.face[1] * 2.6 - L.face[0] * 0.8; p.pos.set(cx, __fp.terrain.heightAt(cx, cz) + p.eye, cz); p.yaw = Math.atan2(cx - L.x, cz - L.z); p.pitch = Math.atan2(L.y - 0.2 - p.pos.y, Math.hypot(cx - L.x, cz - L.z)); __fp.walkers?.leerie?.at(0, 1, 1);

name: peg-2m
js: const L = __fp.livery.peg, p = __fp.player, dx = 10 - L.x, dz = -188 - L.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz), cx = L.x + dx / d * 2, cz = L.z + dz / d * 2; p.pos.set(cx, __fp.terrain.heightAt(cx, cz) + p.eye, cz); p.yaw = Math.atan2(cx - L.x, cz - L.z); p.pitch = Math.atan2(L.y + 0.8 - p.pos.y, 2);

name: net-3m
js: const c = __fp.workers.coheirs, mx = (c.seats[0].x + c.seats[1].x) / 2, mz = (c.seats[0].z + c.seats[1].z) / 2, A = c.axis, p = __fp.player, cx = mx - A[1] * 2.6 + A[0] * 0.6, cz = mz + A[0] * 2.6 + A[1] * 0.6; p.pos.set(cx, __fp.terrain.heightAt(cx, cz) + p.eye, cz); p.yaw = Math.atan2(cx - mx, cz - mz); p.pitch = Math.atan2(__fp.terrain.heightAt(mx, mz) + 0.5 - p.pos.y, 2.6);
